notes.title: Update 2.2.0 Starhenge City Release and Permanent Seasonal Events
notes.notes:
Content Update 2.2.0 includes the release of the long-awaited Starhenge City! All seasonal events have also been changed to permanent events!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25995297/153f9d8cd2c140f681a92609277612f13dbb6369.gif

PATCH NOTES

Starhenge City

Starhenge City had seen the rest of the world of Orake become corrupted as the wildlife became monsters. Instead of trying to fix the problem, they built a cube to protect their society from the terrors outside. Inside the cube is a haven of resources collected and grown before the transformations began. They are highly protective of it and have fortified it with defenses on multiple levels. Starhenge City is known for selfishly protecting its own and not helping outsiders. Nearby Mystica was tormented by not only monsters, but also pirates. And Starhenge did nothing to help out for fear of weakening its own defenses. Gorgraxis was attracted by this selfish ambition and wished to consume them and their resources all the more. The Starhenge residents decided to take advantage of this as an additional defense and to this day Gorgraxis can still be found wandering the cube.

Unlocking Starhenge City will grant you access to abundant fishing, mining, woodcutting, and gathering spots previously restricted to the residents of Starhenge City. Even if you manage to complete the cube key unlocking the city, the citizens of Starhenge City are still apprehensive of outsiders and prefer to seclude themselves within their haven. Starhenge King tasks you with repairing some of the damage caused to the cube by Gorgraxis over the years. And in return will provide you with the fastest axe and pickaxe in game. However, some of the damaged areas can be hard to find.

Permanent Seasonal Events

Every seasonal event has now found a permanent place in Orake!

 Easter Event
 Both Halloween Events (Jack O. Lanterns and the Hallowed Guides)
 Thanksgiving/Turkey Day Event
 Atnas Christmas Event

All of the rewards from the events are available to all in-game as well through the normal ways to acquire them. Missed an event before? Want to get your hands on one of those seasonal cosmetics? Talk to Senna Loveseat in Aracia to be sent to our new Event HUB.

Other Changes

 Changed Cartoon Mask #1, Cartoon Mask #2, and Cartoon Mask #1 (P) names to Pumpkin Mask, Cursed Pumpkin Mask and Purple Pumpkin Mask respectively
 Replaced the "Pumpkin Head" item in the Hallowed Shop with the "Purple Pumpkin Mask" item resolving a duplicate identical item
 Nerfed Hallowed Event EXP gains (Mining/WC and the combat Reward drinks)
 Nerfed Skilling Turkey EXP gains (from consuming them, crafting them gives no experience)
 Bloca Teleport cooldown reduced from 400 seconds to 240 seconds
 All tiers of the StaSta potions no longer give an empty bottle on use
 Whitecoal is now craftable as intended
 The Boneyard (W) map drops items on player death. Everywhere in the boneyard drops your inventory (and boots) when you die, be careful!
 Added two recipes to the Hachi/Ajnin recipe tree to further prevent players from getting stuck when crafting the Hachi's Kudomaskutai

notes.title: Update 2.1.0 Announcement and Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Today, we are releasing content update 2.1.0! Its main features are a keybind editor, boss kill counter, and new equippable item types: Gloves and Necklaces! 

Gloves will usually possess some stats, but most importantly some unique passive effects intended to shake up gameplay a bit. Necklaces will be items with random stats, grant random unique spells while equipped, and will be rerollable using Soulstones (regular and Large, depending on the tier) to get the perfect stats and spell you want!

Necklaces will not be released immediately because more work needs to be done so they behave as intended. However, there will three Gloves available right away! More info on what they do and how to get them will be in the patch notes below.



PATCH NOTES

System Changes
• Implemented a keybind editor. You can access it from the Options menu or pressing default key "\".
• Added support for two new equippable item types: Necklaces and Gloves.
• Added a Boss kill counter (for real this time!).
• The main menu will now show your client version in the top-right corner.
• Revamped the instancing system to avoid potentially overwriting existing permanent maps.
• Reduced the sound effect volume for linear spells.
• Added two more screen resolution options: 1024x576 and 1152x648.
• Fixed a crash related to the config file that may occur when launching the client.
• Fixed a bug when dying in the Boneyard that showed red text "Your inventory is full" even if you had nothing equipped.

General Changes
• Skeleton Archers now have items in their drop table. Their spawn points are now accessible.
• Added a new Gloves item, Bloody Gloves: Grants damage equal to your combat level while unarmed. Dropped by Rockwort Goblins @ 1/250. No level requirement.
• Added a new Gloves item, Magnetic Gloves: Grants a 50% chance not to consume ammo. Dropped by Skeleton Archers @ 1/250. Requires 55 Archery to equip.
• Added a new Gloves item, Manafont Gloves: Grants a 10% chance for your casted spells not to consume mana. Dropped by Mystical Trees @ 1/250. Requires 60 Sorcery to equip.
• Changed the animation for Spike Blade (D)'s Rage attack.
• Changed the sprites of Archangels, Deramaus', and each of the Minotaurs.
• Death Worm: Replaced the 2x T4 Crate drop with Death Worm Egg (R) @ 1/1000.
• Rali: Halved the drop rate on all Ancient Masks and the Angel Ring.
• Old Sailor's Shop: Rounded cooked fish prices and increased prices of non-cooked fish.

notes.title: Update 2.0.5: More bank and spellbook space!
notes.notes:
Update 2.0.5
We have made extensive character changes, so you must have the newest client version to log in and play (version 2.0.5). Get it through steam or itch.

Major Changes
• Added a Total Stats list to highscores! Type something like "/hs total" to see them.
• Added two more bank tabs, one for regular players and another for members. Click the swap tab button on the right to change tabs.
• Added another spellbook!*Press 'X' to swap while the window is open.
• You can now SHIFT+ALT+CLICK resource tiles and items in Shops to take you to the wiki for more info about them.
• Added another cosmetic ring slot (Cosm. Ring 2) to be able to equip wings and a cape or glow, for example.
• Fixed AOE on spells casted by weapons.

Bug Fixes
• Counter skills will now give Endurance experience.
• Speed hacking prompts are now battle messages that don't annoyingly interrupt your game.
• When pressing ALT, item names on the ground will now stack properly instead of overlapping.
• When dying in PVP/unsafe zones, your equipped untradeable items (like most cosmetics) will not be unequipped.
• Fixed a bug where a full potion does not give back the half potion on full inventory.
• You can now swap spells around if other spells are on cooldown. Spells on cooldown still cannot be swapped.
• Fixed a bug where buff spells casted and went on cooldown when already at max buffs.
• You can now equip a two-handed weapon if you have 1 free inventory slot.
• Fixed a bug when selecting 'No' in the item alchemize prompt would continue to ask you every time you double-clicked something.
• Highscores will now save on level up as well as logout.
• Updated default cache when updating/downloading the game to alleviate overflow errors and missing textures.

Visit the wiki at https://orake.fandom.com/wiki/Orake_Wikia
